estimates.assumptions: Standard medium lemon yields ~6g grated zest each; 2 lemons total ~12g. Calorie density matches known value for raw lemon peel/zest.

1 tbs rum ≈ 15 ml (standard measure); 5 tbs = 75 ml. Rum density ~0.92 g/ml but rounded to common 15 g per tbs for volume-weight conversion in recipes; calories from standard 40% ABV dark rum nutritional data.
'Sprinkling' for dusting a 25 cm cake is a modest amount, realistically 8-12 g total used on the surface; 10 g chosen as typical. Calorie density copied from known value.
